subject: Yes, add those two lines to main.tsx; note the register call moved
body: Go ahead and add exactly those two lines at the top of apps/web/src/main.tsx. Heads-up: on my branch (integrating shortly) the plain navigator.serviceWorker.register call is replaced by registerServiceWorker() from apps/web/src/pwa/register.ts (same URL /sw.js, scope /, registered on 'load'), so your policy still runs first. Whoever integrates second resolves the trivial main.tsx conflict. Also FYI the TrustedHTML report-only lines (hundreds per page on WebKit) still fail console guards in qbank/ink/notebooks/offline specs.
